patch.value: Enforce a real coverage gate by running tests against TypeScript sources

Baseline measured 2026-07-29 across one source file (index.ts): 89.97 line, 67.47 branch, 74.36 function coverage. Thresholds are pinned at the measured floor (89/67/74) so the number can only move up.

Tests import TypeScript sources rather than dist so coverage reports on editable lines; the gate fails the build when any threshold regresses; the gate fails when a source file never loads, proven by a negative control; thresholds are recorded in package.json as a ratchet at the measured baseline; the gate runs in the release check and in CI on Node 22 and 26
A coverage gate runs in the release check and in CI on both supported Node lines, reports against TypeScript sources, and fails when a source file is untested or a threshold regresses.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Negative control run: adding an untested __probe.ts to the sources list made the gate exit 1 and name the file,so the presence check is not vacuous.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: The flat-layout source index.ts resolved manifest.json/package.json via ../<file> assuming it ran from dist; running it as a source .ts from the repo root resolved above the repo and fell back to 0.0.0/unknown. readRootJson tries the parent (dist location) then the current directory so both layouts resolve the repo-root file.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Node omits never-loaded files from its coverage report rather than reporting them at zero,so a threshold flag alone is satisfiable by narrowing what the suite imports. Any coverage gate must reconcile the report against the source tree.

value.note: coverageGate config and coverage script wired into release:check
rewriteRelativeImportExtensions so sources import siblings as .ts
coverage gate on a Node 22 and 26 matrix
readRootJson resolves repo-root json from both dist and source-root locations

patch.value: Tests moved onto TypeScript sources and scripts/coverage-gate.ts wired into release:check and CI.

npm run check passes. npm run coverage passes with 45 tests, the single source file (index.ts) present in the report, at 89.97 line, 67.47 branch and 74.36 function coverage. A negative control adding an untested __probe.ts (added to the sources list for a flat layout) made the gate exit 1 and name that file, so the presence check is not vacuous. Thresholds pinned at 89/67/74. The flat-layout source previously resolved manifest.json/package.json via ../ relative to dist; readRootJson now resolves them from both dist and source-root locations so the version/SDK-target reads work when run as a source .ts. The Node 22 and 26 CI legs are unobserved until the pull request runs.
Coverage gate landed and locally verified; the Node 22 and 26 CI legs are unobserved until the pull request runs.
